$comment: GETQUICK packages the blueprint knows, for gq packages check|propose. It holds no version constraints: the blueprint's pins are the require keys of composerFile and each variantComposerFiles file (one pin per package) and the dependencies of npmFile (the commerce Frontend's managed keys); requirementsFile records what each pinned version requires, from the registry. See docs/reference/packages.md.

packages.name: getquick/gq-design
packages.note: Released with @quick-release/design-contract and @quick-release/design-renderer from one gq-design tag at one version (ADR 0018). Both CMS skeletons pin it, and every pinned GETQUICK package's requirement on it must accept the pin (package-requirements.json).

packages.name: getquick/getquick-ecommerce
packages.note: The commerce CMS's WooCommerce authority: its auth routes are the storefront Runtime's upstream (@quick-release/auth-contract).

packages.name: getquick/gq-content
packages.note: The CMS half of the content package pair (ADR 0020): its pin moves only with @getquick/content's, in blueprint/templates/fragments/cms-composer.keys.json and frontend-package.keys.json.

packages.name: getquick/gq-polylang-graphql
packages.note: A multilingual Site requires it itself (docs/guides/sites.md); the blueprint doesn't pin it.

migrations.reason: getquick/getquick-theme registers the primary menu location and supplies design defaults; deploy/ploi/admin.sh requires it installed, admin.d/10-theme.sh activates it and gq site readiness checks its menu. Adopting gq-theme needs an explicit migration, not a version bump.
